method: Read all 326 persistence, integrity, backup, identity, terminal and delivery propositions, all 51 context profiles and two exact caption occurrence sets. Full family-ownership and source regression matrices already read in prior passes are reused as exact governing contexts, with current authority and boundary passages revisited. Every complete semantic payload is compared against immutable predecessor evidence. All 7,313 original occurrence bindings and insertion-spanning fragments are verified against exact source bytes. Current semantic domains and all-prerequisite closure are distinguished from fixed storage, authority, byte custody, transaction, metadata and hash-subject structures. No implementation, tests or proof results were opened.

decisions.PRESERVED_CANONICAL: The pinned Unicode data identities, exact conformance requirement, declared hash/pointer sets and no implicit preimages remain. Ordered arrays remain ordered; only explicitly registered duplicate-rejecting identity-sorted set normalizers apply. A/E preserve exact strings/order and D native parsing is not canonical serialization. Exact normalized-object preimage and current operation scope are separate changed atoms.
decisions.PRESERVED_REGISTRY: UNDEFINED_DERIVATION continues to block acceptance for undefined release-bearing semantics. Newly supplied A–F2 definitions close particular domains without weakening this generic rule. Actual complete current registry meaning is separately changed; implementation publication cannot supply source authority.
decisions.PRESERVED_STORE_AND_INTEGRITY: The single named database and three stores, ordered atomic compare-and-swap, stale-tab rejection, notification-only BroadcastChannel, canonical hash check, quarantine/read-only boundary and exact permitted separate recovery actions remain. No C/D/E amendment permits silent normalization, in-place repair or partial activation of corrupt data.
decisions.PRESERVED_STORAGE_AND_EXPORT: Persistent storage/quota requests and truthful limitations remain. The exact complete-export family list requires preserving all existing canonical/raw/validation/proposal/receipt/manifest/event/metadata/artifact bytes, including amended contents when present. Export membership is not derivation or semantic acceptance of those contents. Import byte verification and failure atomicity remain; actual current identity validation is separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_RESERVATION: The atomic precondition/slot transaction, exact retry ordering, application identity and cryptographic nonce allocation, single committed revision, closed reservation states, current-binding resume, terminal-before-replacement and conflicting-payload rejection remain. F1 preserves these controls; F2 grants no alternative authority. This never presumes an old amended dependency scope current.
decisions.PRESERVED_DELETE_CLONE: Minimal external-to-project DELETE/CLONE receipts retain their exact identity/payload/mapping/result bindings and exact-retry behavior. Deleted substantive content is absent from tombstones. C occurrence identities do not authorize content collapse, duplicate clones or conflicting retries.
decisions.PRESERVED_BACKUP: The distinct four custody states and actual evidence basis, same-origin limitation, exact encryption profile/parameters and secret constraints, export-custody threshold, checkpoint ID and preauthorization ordering remain. C retained child bytes are subject to the same rules; F2 response echoes never prove backup custody. Actual current prerequisite closure is separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_EXTENSION: E expressly retains the original-byte-first rule and exact parsed-only fallback provenance. Unknown extensions remain nonoperative, nongating, nonexecutable, default prompt-excluded and untrusted without explicit migration. Inclusion in an identity hash grants no authority or favorable evidence.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGING: The exact staged lifecycle, no pending metadata reference, detection of every named orphan/interrupted/one-sided condition and no partial canonical relationship remain. C1 response transport stays unchanged. Actual valid-operation resume semantics are separately changed; no staging state becomes semantic approval.
decisions.PRESERVED_AUTHENTICITY: Co-stored hashes establish self-consistency only. Coordinated replacement is not authenticated, and AUTHENTICATED still needs independently held verified evidence under a registered contract. Exact checkpoint fields and actual evidence-level labels remain. C hashes and F2 echoes supply neither trusted time nor verified external possession.
decisions.PRESERVED_ARTIFACT_AND_CANDIDATE: Canonical artifact/authorized filename joins, exactly-one identity matches and rejection cases, immutable pre-inspection candidate set and exact metadata, same-current-set authorization and conservative change invalidation remain. Byte equality never substitutes for required representation/package inspection; C occurrence accounting and D tests cannot waive it.
decisions.PRESERVED_TERMINAL_STRUCTURE: The idempotent single atomic terminal sequence, revision handling, Stage28 identity/human intent checks, exact chain digest, commit and fixed exact hash-record membership remain. Changed prerequisite contents and due evidence must be separately evaluated; no summary, old digest or authorization is accepted as current proof.
decisions.PRESERVED_RESPONSIBILITY: The responsible-stage map remains the declared family stage or earliest consuming gate for global families. F1 preserves owning Stage07/15 writers and Stage17 REGRESSION authority; A/B/D/E preserve existing canonical authority. Conservative invalidation, terminal-only versus premise-refuting classification and regression-discipline repair remain. This does not certify current record contents, test coverage or release.
decisions.PRESERVED_DESTINATION: The exact recipient/destination/purpose/channel/disclosure/artifact/filename/validity/expiry/count/assurance/checkpoint binding and UNKNOWN blocking remain. A affected context and F1 route selection confer no delivery authority. F2 cannot replace permission or trusted-time evidence; device time stays annotation-only when stronger time is required.
decisions.PRESERVED_DELIVERY: The non-stage-increasing authorized export/share action, exact byte/destination/count reverification, delivery-attempt fields and evidence-based status labels remain. Authorization is not physical transfer and a response echo is not transfer evidence. A successful authorized scoped attempt remains required when delivery is the requested outcome; no claimed undo or control outside the action path.
decisions.PRESERVED_SELF_VALIDITY: A derived record does not invalidate itself solely because its own atomic commit increments revision. It binds its actual committed revision, and later relevant dependency mutation makes it stale. Changed dependency-closure contents are separately reconciled; no obsolete closure is endorsed.
decisions.PRESERVED_ORIGIN: The exact GitHub Pages origin, host, production environment, base path, redirect and same-origin resource boundary remain, with every enumerated rejection. Identical bytes at another origin cannot satisfy this deployment identity. No amendment authorizes a new origin or runtime-resource root; no website was inspected.
decisions.EXACT_COMPARE_AND_SWAP_CONTEXT: The exact original compare-and-swap heading governs only original2923–2934 and its three identified child obligations. No new clause is absorbed into this caption; atomic order, stale-tab exclusion and notification-only channel semantics remain.
decisions.EXACT_ARTIFACT_REJECTION_CONTEXT: The Reject caption retains exactly original3125–3131 and its seven identified rejection children. It preserves missing/extra/duplicate/multiple/reorder/rename/stale-audit rejection without widening the occurrence set or substituting for current semantic approval.
decisions.EXACT_NORMALIZED_OBJECT_HASH_PREIMAGE: E fixes the normalized variance hash to the entire normalized object, including preserved embedded canonical-JSON extension context, while enclosing ID/test/freeze/scope/status remain outside that inner value and bound by their own enclosing hashes. This specific owning-schema preimage now governs the generic exact registered-hash rule. No hash establishes semantic acceptance.
decisions.CURRENT_OPERATION_SCOPE_DIMENSIONS: Current exact operation scope consumes A lifecycle, B accepted availability, D semantic identities, E normalized test/variance snapshot and F1/F2 compatible history/fixture/target/input dependencies. Existing closed dimensions, target reservation and canonical hashing remain; no invented scope field or route authority is allowed.
decisions.CURRENT_REGISTERED_SEMANTICS_AND_CLOSURE: The complete current controlling registry/normalizer universe includes applicable A requests/answers, B proof binding, C/C1 accounting, D native semantics, E variance and F1/F2 conditional route/input contracts. Version, identity and invalidation rules remain. Historical reference qualifiers are preserved pending explicit effective-dependency linkage, not construed as still missing resolved policy text.
decisions.CURRENT_IMPORT_IDENTITY_VALIDATION: Before activation, actual current identity validation covers amended input/lifecycle, proof relationships, occurrence accounting, native semantics, normalized test snapshots and conditional execution bindings. All bytes still require validation and failures leave existing projects unchanged. No representation migration, matching hash or old proof establishes current semantic approval.
decisions.CURRENT_TERMINAL_PREREQUISITES_AND_CLOSU: Actual release eligibility, evidence-chain completeness, registry integrity, terminal prerequisites/blockers, delivery-record validity and exact pre-delivery/current dependency closure consume applicable A–F2 current acceptance/accounting/due-test/execution/evidence duties. Preserved transaction, ownership, exact hash records, backup custody threshold and physical-transfer distinctions grant no waiver of UNKNOWN or due material. No source-only disposition is application proof.
decisions.CURRENT_STAGING_RESUME_VALIDITY: Resuming the exact valid operation applies current A input lifecycle, B availability, D semantic identity, E normalized test binding and F1/F2 route/input prerequisites. Original staged-byte lifecycle and failure-record/cleanup alternatives remain; recovery cannot guess missing facts, waive stronger evidence or create partial canonical relationships.
decisions.EXACT_TRANSACTION_OR_ARTIFACT_REJECTION_: The two exact captions retain their individually identified original governed sets: compare-and-swap2923–2934 with three children, and artifact rejection3125–3131 with seven children. Preserve their actor/modality and exact independent-review reason. Do not absorb new clauses or upstream context into these local governed sets.
decisions.CORRECTION_3362: The import-all-identities proposition also consumes A: successor1648 binds canonical request identity, owning input/prompt lifecycle and current scope, and1650 binds current same-project artifact answers. Omitting A from its added governors leaves an applicable current identity/lifecycle dependency untraced. Preserve the proposed CHANGED disposition and other governors, and explicitly add A without granting new import authority.

These historical reference qualifiers are preserved pending explicit per-entry effective-dependency and typed-governor linkage review; they are not a claim that the normative input remains missing or an automatic scope-wide identity change.
